Fire_Alarm.label: Fire Alarm
Fire_Alarm.description: This is an alarm that should be raised if the sensor(s) detect fire, based on the values reported from Temperature, Humidity, Smoke (CO2).

Temperature_Sensor_Location_Tag.label: Temperature Sensor Location Tag
Temperature_Sensor_Location_Tag.description: Verbose identification of the location of the Temperature sensor location

Temperature_Unit.label: Temperature Unit
Temperature_Unit.description: Temperature Units: 0 = Celsius, 1 = Fahrenheit, 2 = Kelvin. All temperature values are represented in this unit.

Temperature_Value.label: Temperature Value
Temperature_Value.description: Last or Current Measured Temperature Value from the Sensor. The value 65534 indicates that the Sensor data is not available.

Minimum_Measured_Temperature_Value.label: Minimum Measured Temperature Value
Minimum_Measured_Temperature_Value.description: The minimum Temperature value measured by the sensor since power ON or reset.

Maximum_Measured_Temperature_Value.label: Maximum Measured Temperature Value
Maximum_Measured_Temperature_Value.description: The maximum Temperature value measured by the sensor since power ON or reset.

Min_Temperature_Range_Value.label: Min Temperature Range Value
Min_Temperature_Range_Value.description: The minimum temperature value that can be measured by the sensor.

Max_Temperature_Range_Value.label: Max Temperature Range Value
Max_Temperature_Range_Value.description: The maximum temperature value that can be measured by the sensor.

Lower_Temperature_Accuracy.label: Lower Temperature Accuracy
Lower_Temperature_Accuracy.description: Indicates the lower end of the accuracy range for the temperature sensor.

Upper_Temperature_Accuracy.label: Upper Temperature Accuracy
Upper_Temperature_Accuracy.description: Indicates the upper end of the accuracy range for the temperature sensor.

Temperature_Threshold.label: Temperature Threshold
Temperature_Threshold.description: Indicates the maximum threshold for the temperature.

Temperature_Sensor_Error.label: Temperature Sensor Error
Temperature_Sensor_Error.description: Temperature Sensor Error: 0 = false (Working correctly), 1 = true (Faulty).

Temperature_Alarm_Loudness.label: Temperature Alarm Loudness
Temperature_Alarm_Loudness.description: Indicates the loudness of temperature alarm.

Humidity_Sensor_Location_Tag.label: Humidity Sensor Location Tag
Humidity_Sensor_Location_Tag.description: Verbose identification of the location of the Humidity sensor.

Humidity_Value.label: Humidity Value
Humidity_Value.description: Last or Current Measured Humidity Value from the Sensor. The value 0 indicates that the Sensor data is not available.

Minimum_Measured_Humidity_Value.label: Minimum Measured Humidity Value
Minimum_Measured_Humidity_Value.description: The minimum Humidity value measured by the sensor since power ON or reset.

Maximum_Measured_Humidity_Value.label: Maximum Measured Humidity Value
Maximum_Measured_Humidity_Value.description: The maximum Humidity value measured by the sensor since power ON or reset.

Humidity_Accuracy.label: Humidity Accuracy
Humidity_Accuracy.description: Indicate the accuracy for the Humidity Sensor.

Humidity_Threshold.label: Humidity Threshold
Humidity_Threshold.description: Indicate the threshold for the Humidity.

Humidity_Sensor_Error.label: Humidity Sensor Error
Humidity_Sensor_Error.description: Humidity Sensor Error: 0 = false (Working correctly), 1 = true (Faulty)

Humidity_Alarm_Loudness.label: Humidity Alarm Loudness
Humidity_Alarm_Loudness.description: Indicates the loudness of the Humidity alarm.

Smoke_Sensor_Location_Tag.label: Smoke Sensor Location Tag
Smoke_Sensor_Location_Tag.description: Verbose identification of the location of the Smoke sensor.

CO2_Alarm_State.label: CO2 Alarm State
CO2_Alarm_State.description: 0 = False (CO2 alarm threshold not exceeded), 1 = True (CO2 alarm threshold exceeded).

CO2_Value.label: CO2 Value
CO2_Value.description: Last or Current Measured CO2 Value from the sensor. The value 0 indicates that the Sensor data is not available.

Minimum_Measured_CO2_Value.label: Minimum Measured CO2 Value
Minimum_Measured_CO2_Value.description: The minimum CO2 value measured by the sensor since power ON or reset.

Maximum_Measured_CO2_Value.label: Maximum Measured CO2 Value
Maximum_Measured_CO2_Value.description: The maximum CO2 value measured by the sensor since power ON or reset.

CO2_Threshold.label: CO2 Threshold
CO2_Threshold.description: Indicate the alarm threshold for the CO2.

Smoke_Sensor_Error.label: Smoke Sensor Error
Smoke_Sensor_Error.description: Smoke Sensor Error: 0 = false (Working correctly), 1 = true (Faulty)

Smoke_Alarm_Loudness.label: Smoke Alarm Loudness
Smoke_Alarm_Loudness.description: Indicates the loudness of smoke alarm

Latitude.label: Latitude
Latitude.description: The decimal notation of latitude, e.g. -43.5723 (World Geodetic System 1984).

Longitude.label: Longitude
Longitude.description: The decimal notation of longitude, e.g. 153.21760 (World Geodetic System 1984).

Altitude.label: Altitude
Altitude.description: Altitude above sea level in meters.

Reset_Temperature.label: Reset Temperature
Reset_Temperature.description: Reset the "Temperature" related parameters to default.

Reset_Humidity.label: Reset Humidity
Reset_Humidity.description: Reset the "Humidity" related parameters to default.

Reset_Smoke_Detection.label: Reset Smoke Detection
Reset_Smoke_Detection.description: Reset the "Smoke" related parameters to default.
